origin: ngspice OSDI netlists written for M17 (decision 0020), and a variant
author: xdylanm
notes: pre_osdi names r2_cmc.osdi without a path; the solver sweep sets NGSPICE_OSDI_DIR to the install's lib/ngspice folder and skips with a reason when the model is not there. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-10.

test_osdi_r2_cmc.cir.note: N with the r2_cmc OSDI model that ngspice 47 ships, one with m=2; pre_osdi r2_cmc.osdi in a .control block (base netlist, written for M17).

test_osdi_r2_cmc_subckt.cir.note: test_osdi_r2_cmc.cir with the N lines in a subcircuit and a braced length (variant).
